name: עַשְׁתְּרֹת
summary: Ashteroth is the first element of Ashteroth-karnaim, the place where Chedorlaomer and the kings with him struck the Rephaim. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם: the Rephaim are struck at Ashteroth-karnaim.

note: Moved from the former word entry `3axetterot` (old root key עשתרת). TIPNR files the compound as Ashteroth-karnaim@Gen.14.5; its separate record Ashtaroth@Deu.1.4 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת, Og’s city) is spelled otherwise and is not named here.
